newsitem.title: JAPAN: Cosmo Oil to spend Y2 bln on handling facilities.
newsitem.headline: Cosmo Oil to spend Y2 bln on handling facilities.

text.p: Cosmo Oil Co Ltd, a leading Japanese oil company, said on Monday that it will spend about two billion yen to expand distribution facilities at three of its refineries.

A Cosmo spokesman said the company decided to begin exchanging oil products with other oil companies, including Japan Energy Corp and Nippon Oil Co Ltd, and plans to boost its distribution facilities to enable it to cope with the increase in oil product handling.
Facilities at Yokkaichi, in central Japan, and Sakai and Sakaide, in western Japan, will be expanded, he said.
The spokesman said that, following the expansion, the three refineries combined will be able to handle 30 percent more product.
Faced with thin profit margins, some oil companies have agreed to supply each other with oil products as a means of cutting costs.
